The BAML HY Spread is currently unknown, leaving the credit regime unconfirmed. Despite the divergence overseas, US breadth metrics are solid, with 60.3% of stocks above their 50-day moving average and 64.1% above their 200-day, indicating healthy participation. This strong internal breadth supports the significant open in the S&P 500 (+0.79%) and especially the Nasdaq 100 (+1.68%).
analysis.analysis_para2: The S&P 500 is testing significant resistance around the 7500 level (currently 7499.36); a decisive break and hold above this on volume would signal continued upside. Immediate support for the S&P 500 sits around 7450, which should hold for sustained momentum. For the Nasdaq 100, watch 30300 as the next potential resistance target, with a key support level around 30000. Given the rising 10Y Yield at 4.49%, monitor its trajectory, as an accelerated climb could eventually pressure growth stock valuations, though currently, tech is shrugging this off.
